items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: my session had Doc Cheatham on trumpet, you on alto

ctx.x: The title of the album was Blues and Jazz From Harlem. Because I know when I came to do my record, I had hooked up with Clyde at that time, and so I decided to build on that record and call my record More Blues and Jazz From Harlem. I remember my session had Doc Cheatham on trumpet, you on alto, Clyde on trombone, June Cole on piano...
That's right. That's who I couldn't think of his name.
